title: ‘Hunger Games’ Series Returns to No. 1 on Soundtracks Chart After More Than a Decade
summary: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping — with music by Noah Kahan, Ella Langley & more — bows atop the Soundtracks chart.
contentText:
The Hunger Games is back on top of Billboard ’s Soundtracks chart, as the latest soundtrack from the long-running film series, The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping , debuts at No. 1 on the list dated Nov. 28. The set includes tracks from Noah Kahan , Ella Langley, Kacey Musgraves and Stevie Nicks.

It’s the first time an album from the franchise has topped the list since the soundtrack from The Hunger Games: Catching Fire , spent one week at No. 1 on the ranking dated Dec. 7, 2013. That film was the second in the series, following The Hunger Games: Songs From District 12 and Beyond , which ruled for five weeks in 2012.

Sunrise On the Reaping is the second prequel of film series, with its events taking place 24 years before those in the first The Hunger Games film.

Here’s a look at all of the soundtracks from The Hunger Games series that have charted on the Soundtracks chart, including any companion score albums that have reached the list:

Title — Peak, Peak Year
The Hunger Games: Songs From District 12 and Beyond – No. 1 for 5 weeks, 2012
The Hunger Games: Original Motion Picture Score – No. 3, 2012
The Hunger Games: Catching Fire – No. 1 for one week, 2013
The Hunger Games: Catching Fire – Original Motion Picture Score – No. 11, 2013
The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 1 – No. 3, 2014
The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 1: Original Motion Picture Score – No. 10, 2014
The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 2 – No. 20, 2015
The Hunger Games: The Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes – No. 3, 2023
The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping , No. 1, 2026
